subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CRAZE’ is written as ‘87’ and ‘MAIZE’ is written as ‘86’. How will ‘DEPART’ be written in that language?
solution: The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] __LOGIC__: Sum of Positional Values of Reverse Positional Letters + Number of letters in the given word = Code. The pattern for this is as follows; In CRAZE → Reverse Positional Letters and positional Values are: C ⇔ X = 24 R ⇔ I = 9 A ⇔ Z = 26
